title: BabelQueue conformance results
description: The machine-readable result of running one SDK package against the cross-SDK conformance suite (ADR-0032 section 2). Sections are keyed by their name in manifest.json; each section maps a case id to {status, reason?}. Case ids: a section's `cases` array gives one case per element, identified by its `name`, else by `<section>#<0-based index>`. A sub-key object that has its own `cases` array yields `<sub-key>/<name>`, or `<sub-key>/<0-based index>` for an unnamed element. Any other object sub-key is a single case keyed by the sub-key. `description` and `schema` are never cases. The manifest's top-level `cases` array is the section named `cases`. Where a section has no `cases` array, a case is identified by its `name`, else by its map key, else by `<section>#<0-based index>`. A `skip` is only legal for an individual case of an in-scope section and MUST carry a `reason` that cites the authorising ADR (`ADR-NNNN`). A section whose scope is a binding the package does not carry is simply absent. A binding that an SDK family deliberately does not support (an ADR-backed entry in the manifest `exceptions` list, for example PHP x asb, ADR-0021) is not listed in `bindings` and its section is absent from results; it is not a skip. A real results file lists every case of every in-scope section; `results.example.json` is abbreviated.

version.description: Version of the package under test.

conformance_version.description: The suite version the run was made against (the value of CONFORMANCE_VERSION).

bindings.description: Every transport/binding the package carries, derived from its modules (ADR-0032 section 2). The list MUST be complete: leaving a carried binding out does not narrow the scope, the package is simply not Compatible. `otel` is listed when the package carries the W3C traceparent extract/inject code of ADR-0028 (in the core for Node and .NET, in a separate module elsewhere); it is not a broker. It is empty for a core-only package. An in-scope section for a listed binding must be present; a section for an unlisted binding must be absent.

reason.description: Why the case failed or was skipped. Required, and it MUST contain an ADR reference (`ADR-NNNN`), when status is `skip`.
